localOnlyFileMeaning: Optional expanded map duplicates retained in the original local checkout. Public canonical inputs and generated pages use exact licensed gzip originals for large layers; byte round trips preserve every vertex, ring, source hash and attribution. The 23 October publication excludes expanded duplicates over 25 MiB to stay below the GitHub Pages site-size limit.
meaning: Original research downloads are retained locally for reproducibility. Public accessibility alone does not establish permission to republish a whole HTML page, PDF or contact directory. Git ignores this cache and public-source packaging excludes it.
publicOutputs: Normalized public names, professional roles, affiliations, official profile/source links and election-result facts with dated source references.
Exact map delivery assets and source/rights manifests under assets/maps/ and content/places/sources/, subject to the recorded original publisher licences and attribution.
verification: The validator hashes retained original files when they exist. An absent local-only research snapshot in a public checkout is recorded separately and does not imply fresh source verification. Delivered map assets remain required.
accessRules: Use legally accessible public sources, honour source licences and access restrictions, retain attribution, and do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or certificate warnings.
